task: Browse 8K Samsung TVs that are open box.
agent_final_answer:
Browsed for open-box 8K Samsung TVs on Best Buy. Path used: Deals menu > Outlet Deals (Best Buy Outlet) > TV & Home Theater Outlet, then applied the Open-Box condition filter and the Samsung brand filter, giving 39 open-box Samsung TVs. In that filtered open-box Samsung listing, the Resolution filter offered only HD (720p), Full HD (1080p), and 4K (2160p) - there is no 8K option, meaning none of the open-box Samsung TVs are 8K.

Cross-verified from the other direction: the main "Samsung 8K TV" search returns 10 results, all Neo QLED 8K models (e.g., Samsung 85"/75"/65" QN990F and QN900F). For those, the Condition facet lists only New and Refurbished (no Open-Box tile), and the per-product "More buying options" panel shows only New and Refurbished sellers.

Conclusion: There are currently no open-box 8K Samsung TVs available at Best Buy. Best Buy's 8K Samsung TVs are offered only as New or Refurbished, and the open-box Samsung TV inventory tops out at 4K resolution.
